A particle often used with nouns to form Karmadhāraya
 and Bahuvrīhi compounds, and with adjectives and adverbs. It has the
 following senses:--

.²2 Beautiful, handsome; as in {#sumaDyamA, sukeSI#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²3 Well, perfectly, thoroughly, properly; {#sujIrRamannaM suvicakzaRaH#}
 {#sutaH suSAsitA strI nfpatiH susevitaH … … sudIrGakAle'pi na yAti#}
 {#vikriyAm#} <ls>H. 1. 22</ls>.
.²4 Easily, readily, as in {#sukara#} or {#sulaBa#} <ab>q. v.</ab>
.²5 Much, very much, exceedingly; {#sudAruRa, sudIrGa#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²6 Worthy of respect or reverence.
.²7 It is also said to have the senses of assent, prosperity, and distress.
